FUTUREWORK - Policy Gate (Dev 3).
 Only the critical release rules live on-chain. Heavy business logic (risk scoring, evidence
 analysis) stays in the application services to limit gas and attack surface.
   milestoneCompleted ┐
   evidenceValid      │
   clientApproved     ├─ all true ─► RELEASE ALLOWED (once per milestone key)
   conditionsSatisfied│
   riskAllowed        ┘
 `key` is keccak256("<projectId>:<milestoneId>"). A key can be released only once, which gives
 on-chain idempotency on top of the database constraint.
@param failedMask bit 0 = milestoneCompleted ... bit 4 = riskAllowed; a set bit means the rule failed
Pure rule evaluation, free to call.
Records the decision. Blocked attempts are logged (not reverted) so they stay auditable.
